about: Market inputs for the List & Host revenue estimator at /estimate/. Every number is an estimate with its basis. Built from AirROI public market pages (trailing 12 months, Aug 2025 to Jul 2026, read Oct 16, 2026), AirROI's April 2026 bedroom and hot tub data, and the booking records of the three homes our team runs.

codes.about: Owner letter codes, live on the estimator since 2026-10-18. A code is 5 characters from the alphabet below: the first character is the market, the second the bedroom count, the last three are random. This map holds only market ids and bedroom counts. The list that ties a code to a person is private and never published. The estimator reads ?c=CODE, shows the code, fills market and bedrooms from it when m and b are absent, and sends Code CODE in the notes of the estimate request. Links and QR codes carry only c, m and b.
codes.bed_chars_note: 6 means 6 or more bedrooms, the estimator's top size. Homes with 1 bedroom are not letter targets, so no character is set for 1. The market other has no character: it is never used for a letter.

offer.platform_fee_basis: Platform fees and discounts, measured on our own bookings: 75 accepted stays at the three homes our team runs, check in dates from July 2026 to June 2027, as booked on October 16, 2026. For each stay we compared the platform payout, before tax, with what guests were charged at list price for the nights, cleaning and pet fees. The gap is the platform's host fee plus any discount or refund. Airbnb kept 19.9 percent (64 stays), Vrbo 8.0 percent (9 stays), or 11.2 percent after the 3.5 percent payment cut we see on Vrbo deposits, and Booking.com 15.0 percent (2 stays, a small sample). Weighted by what guests were charged, that is 18.7 percent, the figure this estimate takes off before our fee.

platform_fees.source: Booking records of the three homes our team runs, accepted stays, with the Vrbo payment cut seen on deposits

scenarios.low: Nightly rate 10 percent under the size adjusted market average, and the revenue per open night of the middle listing in the market (AirROI 50th percentile).
scenarios.likely: The size adjusted market average nightly rate, and the market average revenue per open night.
scenarios.high: Nightly rate 10 percent over the market average, and the revenue per open night of the top quarter (AirROI 75th percentile).

factors.adr_by_bedrooms_basis: Nightly rate relative to a 2 bedroom home. Checked against AirROI April 2026 (Broken Bow: 2 bedrooms $323, 4 bedrooms $575, 6 or more $1,118; Gatlinburg: $276, $507, $1,016) and Red Awning Fort Worth ($153, $197, $285, $405 for 1 to 4 bedrooms). Each market's average is spread across sizes using that market's own bedroom mix from AirROI.
factors.occ_by_bedrooms_basis: AirROI April 2026 shows occupancy nearly flat by size in Broken Bow (38, 37, 38 percent) and slightly lower for big homes in Gatlinburg (48, 46, 43 percent).
factors.cleaning_basis: Market median cleaning fee from AirROI, scaled by size using BNBCalc's Fort Worth cleaning fees by bedroom count ($73, $113, $154, $225 for 1, 2, 3 and 4 or more bedrooms).

sleeps.basis: Our assumption. Groups search by guest count, so room for more guests lifts the nightly rate a little.

baths.basis: Our assumption. Short means fewer baths than half the bedrooms (rounded up). Generous means at least one bath per bedroom, for 2 or more bedrooms.

pets.basis: Our assumption, kept small. Guesty reports pet friendly rentals earned 24 percent more per available night than others, but that gap also reflects that pet friendly homes tend to be bigger.

hot_tub.basis: AirROI April 2026 measured a hot tub lift of 7.9 percent in Broken Bow, 8.3 percent in Blue Ridge and 10.8 percent in Gatlinburg. We use 8 percent in getaway markets and 4 percent (our assumption) in the city markets.

factor_sources: AirROI, cabin markets by bedroom count and hot tub lift, April 2026
Red Awning, Fort Worth nightly rate by bedroom count
BNBCalc, Fort Worth market page, cleaning fee by bedroom count
